sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (offshore International Company regime administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English Common Law, French Civil Law, and indigenous Customary Law); based on the Constitution of the Republic of Vanuatu with statutes consolidated in the Laws of the Republic of Vanuatu.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Vanuatu-China Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 11 July 2006, in force 1 October 2007)
PACER Plus Regional Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (signed 14 June 2017, in force 13 December 2020)
Tax Information Exchange Agreement between Australia and Vanuatu (in force 2010)
Tax Information Exchange Agreement between New Zealand and Vanuatu (in force 2010)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 13 of 2021 (AML/CFT Act) and subordinate AML/CFT Regulations; Beneficial Ownership Act No. 14 of 2021 (BO Act) and Beneficial Ownership Regulations; International Companies Act [Cap 222]; Financial Services Commission Act [Cap 270]; United Nations Act [Cap 189] (UN sanctions implementation); administered and supervised by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) and the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of passport for each shareholder, director, company secretary, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent notary public in the applicant's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Hague Apostille certificate is NOT available; Vanuatu is not a contracting party to the HCCH Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized proof of residential address (utility bill, bank statement, or government registry extract issued within the last 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public utility, licensed financial institution, or government registry in the applicant's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original bank reference letter confirming good standing, issued on bank letterhead and signed by an authorized branch officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Commercial bank maintaining the applicant's account (correspondent/settlement bank relevant to the E-commerce payment rails)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional reference letter for the ultimate beneficial owner(s) (chartered accountant, attorney, or regulated corporate service provider)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed professional firm in the applicant's country of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of every shareholder, director, officer, and UBO against the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, EU and United Kingdom consolidated sanctions lists, FATF public statements and other monitored-jurisdiction advisories, and VFSC/VFIU domestic watchlists; automated PEP matching (heads of state, senior politicians, judiciary, military, immediate family, and close associates) using commercial databases (Refinitiv World-Check or equivalent); any positive hit or adverse media triggers enhanced due diligence and reporting under sections 17-21 of the AML/CFT Act No. 13 of 2021; payment-stack onboarding through Stripe Billing and Authorize.Net additionally enforces US/UK/EU sanctions and restricted-business screening on the entity principals.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_statutory_register_obligation: The VFSC maintains a centralized beneficial ownership register under the BO Act No. 14 of 2021; the registered agent must file the UBO schedule with the VFSC within statutory timelines, with strict confidentiality applicable to the register and supervised-access only for competent authorities (VFSC, VFIU, law enforcement).

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Companies Registry — e-submission of name reservations through VFSC-licensed registered agents under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be expressed in Latin script (English or French); Bislama or other-language names are accepted only with a certified transliteration into Latin characters; the name must end with 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Inc', or another statutory suffix denoting limited liability; no foreign-script-only names are accepted.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If a name is rejected, the licensed registered agent may re-submit the same name with a revised suffix, transliteration, or disambiguating word, or submit an alternative name without an additional VFSC government fee; a formal written appeal may be lodged with the Registrar of Companies through the licensed agent within 14 days of rejection, attaching supporting arguments and, for sensitive tokens, the prior written consent of the relevant supervisory authority (e.g., VFSC for financial-industry words); a name reservation may be extended by written request for one further 30-day period at the Registrar's discretion.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted. The International Company must maintain a statutory registered office in Vanuatu at the premises of its VFSC-licensed resident registered agent, but no physical business premises in Vanuatu is required; the subscription-box operation may be managed remotely, with the registered agent's address serving as the service-of-process and official-correspondence address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low — estimated at 3-5% within the first three years for a Low_Risk_Standard merchant tier; VFSC conducts risk-based inspections chiefly of licensed agents' records and may require digital production of corporate and AML files instead of an on-site visit to the offshore principal's premises.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC International Company name clearance and incorporation registration fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory government tariff under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] (VFSC published fee schedule)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC first-year annual government maintenance fee (prepaid at incorporation)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory annual company fee per VFSC fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent fee — registered office, resident agent, company secretary, statutory registers maintenance, and AML/KYC file administration (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent / corporate service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark (USD 600-900 per annum in the Port Vila corporate-services market)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Beneficial ownership register filing and UBO record maintenance under the BO Act No. 14 of 2021
PEP, sanctions, and adverse-media screening of all shareholders, directors, officers, and UBOs
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed agent / AML data vendor (Refinitiv World-Check or equivalent)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark; AML/CFT Act No. 13 of 2021 customer-due-diligence compliance cost

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and consular legalization of the KYC bundle (passport, address proof, bank and professional references) in country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and Vanuatu diplomatic mission / legalization agency
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial tariff plus consular legalization fee schedule (approximately USD 30-60 per document)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified documentation pack for payment-rail onboarding (Stripe Billing / Authorize.Net) — certified copies of Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, and UBO extract
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: VFSC certified-copy statutory fee plus registered-agent administrative charge

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company statutory kit — share certificates, share ledger, seal/stamp (optional), and bound statutory register books

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act No. 32 of 1993 (Cap. 222) of the Republic of Vanuatu, particularly sections 2 (incorporation), 5 (registration), 13 (share capital), and 47 (registered office); the Companies Act 1986 applies only to domestic companies and is not applicable to International Companies.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registration Division, Port Vila, Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form A (Application for Registration of an International Company) together with the authenticated Memorandum and Articles of Association, submitted through a VFSC-licensed registered agent
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital. The International Company may be incorporated with one or more shares of par or no par value; in practice the subscribers elect 100 ordinary shares of no par value issued as fully paid. No escrow account or capital deposit obligation is imposed under the Act for this low-risk trading entity.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscribers to the Memorandum and Articles of Association subscribe to 100 ordinary shares of no par value at USD 1.00 each, credited as fully paid, pursuant to sections 5 and 13 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]. RESOLVED further that the registered office be established at the licensed registered agent's premises in Port Vila, Vanuatu, and that the address be filed with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission. RESOLVED further that the first director, [Name], be appointed, with authority to open corporate bank accounts, appoint a secretary, and execute all documents for the conduct of the Company's subscription box merchandising business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name clearance and engagement of licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registration Division, via a VFSC-licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the licensed registered agent to conduct a name availability search against the VFSC register of international companies. If the proposed name is distinguishable, the agent reserves the name and obtains the client's executed engagement letter confirming the registered agent and registered office arrangements.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name (with Limitation suffix)
Engagement letter with the VFSC-licensed registered agent
Corporate KYC profile of the beneficial owner and applicants
Passport copies and proof of residential address of directors and shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for conflict or undesirability, file an alternative name; a re-application is processed within one business day at no additional statutory fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and execution of the Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent (acting with notarization authority)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the Memorandum and Articles of Association in conformity with Schedule 1 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]. The subscriber(s) execute the instrument before a witness; the agent certifies execution and affixes its corporate seal where required.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Subscriber signature pages witnessed
Director consent to act
Registered agent consent to act
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar queries any defective clause, the agent files a corrective written resolution and re-executes the affected pages; no re-current public advertisement is required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of incorporation application with the VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, Companies Registration Division (counter at 36 Rue Pierre de Coubertin, Port Vila, or the VFSC e-registry portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent submits Form A, the executed Memorandum and Articles, consents, and the government filing fee of USD 250 to the VFSC. The filing must be accompanied by the activation of the registered office address in Port Vila. Payment is made by bank transfer or banker's draft in favor of the VFSC.
required_dossiers: Form A (Application for Registration of an International Company)
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Director and secretary consents
Registered agent's approval of registered office
Government fee receipt (USD 250)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, the VFSC issues a notice of defect; the agent rectifies and resubmits within 14 days. Non-rectification results in deemed abandonment, and a fresh application with a new fee is required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, Registrar of International Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation and assigns a unique company registration number. The agent verifies the certificate, company name, and date of incorporation, then produces the statutory company file for the client.
required_dossiers: VFSC approval memo
Certificate of Incorporation
Registered office certificate
Sealed copy of the Memorandum and Articles
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains a clerical error in name or date, the agent files a written request for rectification with the Registrar; the corrected certificate is reissued within two business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation governance and bank account formalities
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: First board of directors of the International Company; commercial banks licensed by the Vanuatu Reserve Bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The sole director convenes the inaugural board meeting, adopts the First Board Resolution, approves the issue of shares to the subscriber, confirms the registered office and officers, and authorizes transactional banking operations for the subscription box business. The resolution is minuted and retained in the corporate records with the registered agent.
required_dossiers: First Board Resolution
Minutes of the inaugural board meeting
Certificate of Incorporation
Share register and register of directors
Director identification documents and bank account opening forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requires enhanced due diligence, the board adopts a written consent resolution approving the account and provides a certificate of incumbency issued by the registered agent; the company is not deemed defective for such administrative delay.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Department of Industry, Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Commerce of Vanuatu
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No manufacturing or industrial operating permit is required for a subscription box merchandising business conducted as offshore e-commerce; a general business license under the Business License Act [Cap. 13] is relevant only if the company maintains a physical trading or warehousing premises open to the public inside Vanuatu, which is not contemplated for this International Company structure.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Environment, Energy and Disaster Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Low Impact Activity under Schedule 2 of the Environmental Management and Conservation Act [Cap. 283]; dry storage and mail-order logistics for subscription boxes do not trigger a full EIA report or registration
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No specific EPA discharge thresholds apply to the pure logistics and repacking of consumer goods; the operation must however comply with the general municipal solid waste segregation and disposal requirements of the Port Vila Municipality, the Waste Management Regulations of 2023, and the prohibition on open burning under the Air Pollution Control standards of Vanuatu if any auxiliary warehouse activity is ever localized on shore.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety clearance, structural load inspection, and workplace safety certification must be obtained from the Vanuatu Police Force Fire Service for any ancillary storage premises, in compliance with the National Building Code of Vanuatu and the Occupational Health and Safety requirements administered by the Department of Labour. If the subscription box company operates solely offshore with baggage handling, packing, or light assembly activities, the employer must still maintain a written workplace safety policy, adequate fire extinguishing equipment, and first-aid readiness in the registered agent's office premises.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Service (VCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu; official portal: https://customs.gov.vu. Company and tax-exemption registration is administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) at https://www.vfsc.vu. Investment facilitation is handled by the Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Vanuatu does not levy national income tax, capital gains tax, or withholding tax and does not operate a general domestic Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) system for income tax purposes. An International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] receives its statutory identifier (VFSC Registration Number / I.C. No.) directly from the VFSC upon incorporation. Because the IC is exempt from all Vanuatu taxes on international business activities, it is not required to register with VCIR for income tax or VAT purposes and files no annual tax return. If the IC physically moves goods through Vanuatu customs, it (or its licensed customs broker) must obtain a customs import/export processing account with the VCIR Customs Division; no fiscal TIN is assigned. Foreign investment participation in the IC is permitted without local ownership; a Foreign Investment Certificate (FIC) is conditionally required for foreign enterprises carrying on restricted onshore activities, but an IC's offshore subscription-box operations are generally outside the FIC regime. For AML/CTF purposes, the IC must maintain beneficial-ownership records with licensed registered agents under the AML/CTF Act [Cap 293].
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Under section 51 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222], the IC elects to claim statutory tax exemption by applying to the VFSC each year for a Certificate of Tax Exemption and paying the prescribed annual government fee; the exemption covers income, capital gains, corporate taxes, stamp duties, and all present forms of national taxation arising from international business activities. No US-style check-the-box election exists, and Vanuatu has no local hybrid-mismatch or tax-transparent classification rules because it imposes no CIT/VAT. The IC is statutorily restricted from carrying on business with Vanuatu residents or owning Vanuatu real property (except under prescribed exemptions), and breach of these restrictions may void the exemption and expose the entity to municipal business licence taxes and penalties.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No national VAT or GST regime in force in Vanuatu; indirect taxation is limited to customs import duty under the Customs Act [Cap 145] and the Customs Tariff Act, excise duty on selected goods, municipal council business licence taxes, and stamp duty on limited instruments. Exports of subscription-box merchandise are not subject to any Vanuatu indirect tax.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable - there is no VAT/GST registration threshold because no VAT/GST statute exists. A customs processing account is required for physical import/export clearances, and a municipal business licence (nominal annual fee in VUV) is required only if the IC conducts domestic onshore business in Vanuatu, which an IC is generally prohibited from doing.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu imposes no real-time e-invoicing, fiscal clearance, digital stamping, or API-based tax clearance mandate for B2B or B2C transactions. Customs transactions are declared through the electronic single-window system ASYCUDA World operated by VCIR, which requires electronic lodging of export/import declarations and supporting documents, but there is no tax-authority pre-clearance of commercial invoices. Subscription payments received through Stripe Billing or Authorize.Net are subject to standard AML/CFT record-keeping rather than to any e-invoicing tax-control regime.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable - because Vanuatu has no VAT/GST, exports are not 'zero-rated'; there is no VAT output tax to zero-rate and no VAT refund mechanism. Goods exported from Vanuatu are outside the scope of any Vanuatu indirect tax, and subscription-box merchandise exported by an IC is not subject to export duty unless specifically scheduled under Vanuatu customs tariff law (consumer packaged goods are generally not scheduled). Import duty paid on goods brought temporarily into Vanuatu and later re-exported is not refundable under a VAT/drawback mechanism because that mechanism does not exist; the IC is therefore advised to arrange drop-shipment so that goods do not enter Vanuatu customs territory.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration lodged electronically via ASYCUDA World (Vanuatu Customs)
Negotiable transport document (bill of lading or air waybill) evidencing physical export
IC registration certificate and customs processing account reference (if physical export through Vanuatu)
Inward remittance or bank credit evidence retained in banking records (not tax-mandated in Vanuatu)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT zero-rating fraud or tax-clawback regime exists because Vanuatu levies no VAT/GST. Scrutiny is limited to: (i) accuracy of customs export declarations under the Customs Act [Cap 145], where false declarations attract fines, forfeiture of goods, and prosecution; (ii) compliance with the International Companies Act [Cap 222] and the annual Certificate of Tax Exemption maintenance, failure of which can result in loss of tax-exempt status and retrospective municipal liability; (iii) AML/CFT record-keeping obligations under the AML/CTF Act [Cap 293] for beneficial ownership and transaction monitoring; and (iv) sanctions/export-control screening where subscription-box goods are shipped to restricted destinations. There is no statutory 180-day foreign-exchange repatriation deadline under Vanuatu law: the Vatu (VUV) is freely convertible, and the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu imposes no exchange-control obligation on export proceeds. This field is recorded as '0' to reflect the absence of any legally mandated repatriation deadline.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) and the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC). The RBV is the exchange-control authority under the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 97] and issues administrative Exchange Control Notices enforced through RBV-designated authorised dealers, while the VFSC is the registrar and AML/CFT supervisor for Vanuatu International Companies.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu operates a liberalised exchange-control regime rather than full statutory deregulation. Current-account payments for imports, logistics, gateway commissions, and professional fees are freely executable through authorised dealers without prior RBV approval. Capital-account inflows and outflows attributable to a non-resident Vanuatu International Company do not require per-transaction approval but are subject to evidence-based filing by the authorised dealer. The Vatu (VUV) is an independently floating currency in a thin domestic market; settlement is available through four authorised-dealer banks. Profit remittance is legally unrestricted and the tax-exempt IC faces no dividend withholding tax or income tax in Vanuatu. The practical convertibility friction is institutional de-risking: FATF grey-listing history and correspondent-bank policies compel banks to demand proof of beneficial ownership, trade substance, and source of funds before executing distributions. An IC may elect a foreign functional currency and retains only operational VUV exposure for local outlays.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Exchange-control surrender obligations apply to Vanuatu-resident exporters: export proceeds must be repatriated to an authorised dealer within the contractual settlement window (standard dealer guidance requires receipt within 30 days of the relevant shipment date) and converted into Vatu where the underlying contract is denominated in foreign currency. This surrender mandate does not apply to a Vanuatu International Company formed under the International Companies Act [Cap. 259], because the IC is statutorily treated as a non-resident offshore entity conducting business outside Vanuatu. The exemption is maintained by annual filing of: (i) the VFSC Certificate of Compliance, (ii) board minutes confirming that all gross revenue is derived from non-resident customers, and (iii) the IC's designated non-resident identifier maintained by the RBV-authorised dealer. Failure to refresh these records can retroactively subject foreign-currency receipts to repatriation and forced VUV conversion on an invoice-level basis.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account / Multi-Currency Settlement Account (USD, AUD, VUV)
Capital Escrow Account / Multicurrency Corporate Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: MEDIUM-HIGH as an ancillary settlement layer, but not as a replacement for the Vanuatu bank-account requirement. Stripe Billing and Authorize.Net are the targeted gateway rails and are characterised in the treasury architecture as payment-institution collection lockboxes; they are typically registered to an operating entity in the US/EU and swept daily to the VU IC's USD account at an authorised dealer. Offshore digital EMIs such as Airwallex, Ebury, or OFX-platform equivalents are legally viable for multi-currency collection, FX-cost compression, and batch disbursement to subscription-box suppliers, provided no Vanuatu deposit-taking business is conducted. Under the Vanuatu Banking Act [Cap. 46], an entity may not hold itself out as accepting deposits in Vanuatu without an RBV bank licence, so an offshore EMI must remain a non-deposit-taking payment trigger. All funds must ultimately clear to the VU IC's on-island or offshore authorised-dealer account; the bank's EDD file will re-trace every EMI disbursement and treat off-platform cash flows as a compliance red flag.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A physical or recorded-live KYC interview is mandatory for first-time onboarding of a 100% foreign-owned International Company in the subscription-commerce sector. ANZ and BSP maintain remote/video KYC protocols for Low-Risk corporates provided a Vanuatu-licensed registered agent notarially certifies uploaded documents, a compliance officer conducts a live recorded interview on a video conference, and all directors produce an ICAO-compliant passport plus a second government-issued ID. Bred may additionally require consular or apostille legalisation of passports and original corporate board resolutions. Purely documentary onboarding through a power-of-attorney without any director interview is generally refused in the post-FATF-grey-listing environment, particularly where the company transacts exclusively through card gateways. Following the interview, the IC must file VFSC updates within 14 calendar days for any change in directors or beneficial owners.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: FATF/APG jurisdictional risk: Vanuatu was grey-listed during the 2022-2024 cycle and remains under enhanced monitoring; offshore International Companies are associated with undisclosed beneficial ownership and tax-evasion typologies.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified VFSC Certificate of Incorporation with live registry search output; Certificate of Good Standing dated within 30 days of onboarding; constitutional documents confining the IC to ISIC 4791 subscription-box commerce; registered agent's AML/KYC attestation; group structure chart; board resolution committing to VFSC beneficial-ownership filing; documented evidence of the jurisdiction's FATF de-listing progress.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership opacity and the IC's statutory confidentiality privileges: nominee shareholders, historical bearer-share issuance, and lack of economic substance in Port Vila.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current shareholder register and beneficial-owner register filed with VFSC; notarised share transfer records; natural-person passports of all ultimate beneficial owners legalised and translated into English or French; professional-reference letters and director CVs demonstrating relevant e-commerce competence; lease agreement for the registered office in Vanuatu plus storage/fulfilment contracts abroad evidencing actual day-to-day management of the subscription-box brand.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume card-not-present subscription payments: repetitive microcredits, chargeback volatility, and the risk that boxed merchandise serves as a conduit for third-party fraud proceeds or refund-laundering.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Payment-gateway compliance pack including Stripe Billing and Authorize.Net underwriting correspondence; chargeback KPI dashboard targeting a chargeback rate below 0.9% and refund rate below 5%; product catalogue with ISIC 4791 classification and HS/UNC codes for box components; consumer terms of sale; fulfilment-logistics contracts; audit-log extracts demonstrating 1:1 order-to-supplier cash matching; quarterly data-room access undertaking to the bank's monitoring team.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Correspondent-bank de-risking: US or EU respondent banks may refuse USD wires referencing a Vanuatu IC, and the onboarding bank's internal sector policy may block offshore e-commerce structures outright.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Documentary proof that USD card flows originate through regulated US/EU payment gateways; physical fulfilment contracts in Hong Kong, Shenzhen, or other Asian logistics hubs; warehouse and freight invoices; IC board minutes confirming the entity operates solely as IP-holder and commercial hub; evidence of intent to route USD via SWIFT GPI through the authorised dealer's nostro network; certification that no bearer instruments exist; reference letter and source-of-wealth statement from the beneficial owner's home-country banker.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unverified source of initial capital: the IC has a minimum capital of nil, so the first injection can appear as a gift or loan from an unconnected third party, triggering suspicion of third-party fund mobility.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board resolution precisely recording the amount, purpose, and mechanism of the capital injection; 12-month source-of-funds bank statements of the funding shareholder; SWIFT MT103 confirmation bearing ISO purpose code EQUI; executed share subscription agreement and share certificates; licensed accountant's source-of-funds attestation; tax-residence certificate of each funding shareholder from its domestic revenue authority.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant route: the beneficial owner's home bank initiates a SWIFT MT103 with field 70 remittance information coded 'EQUI - SHARE CAPITAL - VU__VU__VU_IC__ISIC_4791_08_SUBSCRIPTION_BOX_SERVICE'; the beneficiary is the IC's USD-denominated account at ANZ or Bred. The authorised dealer must hold in advance a certified KYC pack comprising the VFSC Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, board resolution approving the share issue, executed share subscription schedule, and an ISIC 4791 business plan. The dealer records the credit as equity capital on the monthly RBV electronic exchange-control report, which is the only statutory verification required for a non-resident IC. If the injection takes the form of a shareholder loan, the wire must use ISO purpose code LOAN with a signed shareholder-loan agreement and an arm's-length interest rate documented in the group's transfer-pricing file. No VUV conversion is required at the entry point; the IC maintains USD as its functional currency and may hold VUV balances only for domestic operating costs.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Routine supplier invoices for box components, packaging, and freight below approximately USD 25,000 clear by SWIFT MT103 through the authorised dealer or through an EMI batch-settlement rail using ISO purpose codes SUPP (supplier payment) or INTC (intra-group payment where procurement is routed through an affiliate); SWIFT GPI is recommended for end-to-end tracking and rapid reconciliation. For container-scale inventory builds, the bank will structure a Commercial Letter of Credit, sight or 30-day usance, issued in favour of the supplier and payable against original bill of lading, commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, and CMR where applicable; the LC transaction gives the bank documentary assurance and reduces the frequency of ad hoc AML reviews. Gateway and EMI balances are swept daily from Stripe Billing and Authorize.Net to the IC's authorised-dealer USD account, with residual VUV amounts converted at spot only for bonded-warehouse rent, customs handling, port fees, and local professional services.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright VUV/USD forward contract with a maturity of 31 days to 12 months through an RBV-authorised dealer, documented as trade-hedging for the subscription-box import cycle and local logistics costs.

Non-deliverable forward (NDF) on VUV/USD concluded with an offshore banking counterparty and settled in USD, permissible while the IC remains a non-resident entity without a VUV-collateralised loan requiring a deliverable hedge.
Cross-currency swap and FX-swap ladder between USD and VUV executed under an ISDA 2002 master agreement with an authorised dealer for seasonal working-capital management.

European-style USD/VUV currency options purchased by the IC on a buy-side premium basis only, used to cap conversion cost on optional dividend distributions and prohibited for speculative option-selling.

Natural-supply-chain hedge through USD-nominated supplier contracts matched to gateway USD receipts, with weekly spot conversion of only the residual VUV operating outlay in accordance with the dealer's FX policy.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: VFSC Annual Return for an International Company (standard filing covering solvency/compliance declaration, directors, share capital, beneficial ownership and tax-residence schedule)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Companies and International Trusts Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary rule: on or before each anniversary of the date of incorporation; the licensed Vanuatu Registered Agent lodges the return and pays the prescribed fee on the anniversary date (VFSC grants no extension; agent invoices 30-60 days before the anniversary).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 25% late-payment surcharge on the annual fee under the VFSC fee schedule; statutory offence under International Companies Act (Cap 222) s.108 attracting a fine up to VUV 1,000,000 (~USD 8,300) plus a continuing daily default fine of VUV 10,000 (~USD 83); persistent non-filing (usually 3-12 months) results in administrative strike-off, dissolution and escheat of company assets to the Republic of Vanuatu.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Re-Confirmation and Statutory Registers Certification (director-signed declaration delivered to the Registered Agent and annexed to the VFSC annual return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Vanuatu Registered Agent; VFSC (as annex to the annual return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary rule: UBO declaration and register review must be completed before the agent lodges the annual return on the incorporation anniversary; identity re-verification on a 12-month risk-based cycle.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Invalid or false UBO declarations: fine up to VUV 1,000,000 plus daily default VUV 10,000 under the International Companies Act and the Prescribed Information Regulations; the agent is legally barred from certifying the annual return until the register is complete, triggering late-filing penalties and strike-off exposure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited Financial Statements and Independent Auditor's Report (conditional: filed only when the board resolves to audit or members holding at least 10% of voting rights demand an audit)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC (copy lodged through the Registered Agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 15 days after the auditor's report is received by the company; no fixed annual calendar deadline for non-audited exempt International Companies.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to lodge the triggered audit report: fine up to VUV 1,000,000 plus daily default VUV 10,000; VFSC may refuse to process the following year's annual return until the overdue report is filed.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% - Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax at the national level; an International Company (IC) is additionally protected by the absolute statutory tax exemption in section 139 of the International Companies Act, Cap. 222 (ICA).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Effective tax rate is nil. No corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no payroll tax, no branch profits tax, no inheritance or gift tax, no exchange controls, and no stamp duty on IC share transfers. The exemption covers all profits and income of the IC irrespective of source, so the subscription-box merchandising business accrues zero national tax cost.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: NONE - No corporate income tax return form exists in Vanuatu. An IC cannot file and is not required to file any income tax computation, declaration, or assessment with the Vanuatu Domestic Revenue Department.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Not applicable for corporate income tax (no filing obligation).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Not applicable (the statutory exemption operates automatically and requires no annual claim or election).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box N/A - Nil tax filing position
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory exemption under s.139 ICA: the IC, its shareholders, directors, officers, and employees are exempt from all Vanuatu income or other taxes on the IC's profits or income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No return is filed; no advance ruling or exemption certificate is required for Vanuatu law purposes. The registered agent records the nil-tax confirmation in its records.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Not applicable - no failure penalty can arise for non-filing of a non-existent income tax return. However, if the IC later loses its exempt status (e.g., by trading locally without approval), the full domestic tax regime, including penalties and interest on underpaid amounts, may apply.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Return and Renewal - International Companies Act, Cap. 222; filed by the licensed registered agent through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) online registry portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 30 days after each anniversary of the date of incorporation, together with payment of the annual government fee prescribed by the VFSC fee schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 - Company name and registration number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name of the IC and its unique VFSC registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the exact name and number on the certificate of incorporation; any discrepancy triggers a VFSC query and potential late-renewal penalty.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 - Registered office address in Vanuatu
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical address of the licensed registered office maintained by the registered agent in Port Vila or Luganville.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A PO Box alone is insufficient; the physical office of the Vanuatu registered agent must be stated.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, nationalities, and service addresses of all directors and the company secretary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted; nominee arrangements are recognized but the beneficial owner must be disclosed to the registered agent for AML/KYC records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered shareholders, class of shares, number of shares issued, and aggregate par value.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: 100% non-resident ownership is allowed; bearer shares are prohibited and circulating bearer instruments must be dematerialized.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that the IC continues to hold exempt status under s.139 ICA and has not engaged in prohibited domestic trading.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare whether any business has been conducted with Vanuatu residents; affirmative disclosure subjects the IC to the Business Licence Act and potential loss of exemption.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late renewal attracts monetary late fees imposed by the VFSC; continued non-payment results in administrative penalties, suspension, and ultimately strike-off/deregistration of the IC under the ICA.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: ESR Annual Notification - International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019 (as amended); submitted through the VFSC ESR online filing channel by the registered agent on behalf of the IC.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (synchronized with the VFSC annual renewal cycle).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The date directed by the VFSC; in practice the ESR notification is filed at the same time as the VFSC annual return and renewal.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation of whether the IC is within the scope of the Economic Substance Act.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All ICs must answer; the IC must state that it is a relevant entity carrying on a relevant activity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Classification of the relevant activity. Subscription-box merchandising falls under distribution and service centre business.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the IC purchases goods from a related party and resells them to customers, or distributes goods/services for a related party, the correct classification is distribution and service centre.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: ESR Box 3 - Gross income from relevant activity
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Amount of gross income derived by the IC from the relevant activity in the reporting period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the worldwide gross revenue of the subscription-box activity; no deduction of costs is permitted at this box.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: ESR Box 4 - Economic substance test outcome
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC satisfies the economic substance test for the relevant activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The IC must confirm management and direction in Vanuatu, adequate employees and premises, proportionate operating expenditure, and performance of core income-generating activities in Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Acknowledgment that the VFSC may exchange the filed information with foreign tax authorities under international transparency agreements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The IC and its registered agent must execute the consent; refusal may trigger a penalty and adverse listing.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file the ESR notification or filing a false notification is punishable by court-imposed penalties of up to VUV 10,000,000 and/or imprisonment of up to 2 years, plus continuing daily default fines; the VFSC may also strike off the IC.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VAT Return (only if the IC is VAT-registered) - Value Added Tax Act; filed with the Vanuatu Domestic Revenue Department in the prescribed electronic or paper form.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Monthly or bi-monthly tax period as assigned by the Commissioner of Domestic Revenue.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Return and payment due within 21 days after the end of the assigned VAT tax period.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Value of subscription-box sales to non-resident customers physically delivered outside Vanuatu or exported.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Export supplies are zero-rated; maintain shipping documentation, customs export evidence, and non-resident customer records to support the zero-rating.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Value of any supplies made in Vanuatu to residents at the standard 12.5% rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An IC that sells in Vanuatu risks breaching the ICA local-trading prohibition and must instead hold a Business Licence; such sales are standard-rated.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Recoverable VAT on local purchases and imports attributable to taxable supplies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign-input VAT is not recoverable; claim only Vanuatu VAT borne on local fulfillment, storage, and agency expenses.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing and late payment attract default assessments, penalty tax, and interest under the VAT Act; intentional evasion is a criminal offence punishable by fines and imprisonment, with personal liability of directors and officers.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Vanuatu imposes no withholding tax on dividends, deemed dividends, or any distribution made by an IC to resident or non-resident shareholders, and no exchange-control restriction applies to the remittance of profits.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable - Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network. The operative relief for a non-resident shareholder is the domestic statutory exemption (s.139 ICA), which eliminates withholding at source. If the shareholder's home jurisdiction requires evidence for foreign tax credit purposes, the registered agent may obtain an administrative tax status letter from the Vanuatu Domestic Revenue Department confirming that no Vanuatu tax was imposed; a formal treaty-based Tax Residence Certificate is not available because Vanuatu currently imposes no income tax and has no DTA network.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate is 0% for both cross-border royalties and interest. Vanuatu imposes no withholding tax on interest, royalties, management fees, or technical fees payable by an IC to non-residents, and no deemed-interest or notional-royalty recharacterization is codified in the ICA exemption.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory threshold - Vanuatu has no transfer-pricing legislation and prescribes no Local File or Master File monetary thresholds in VUV. Instead, the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019 imposes a Vanuatu substance test for the distribution and service centre relevant activity: (i) the IC is directed and managed in Vanuatu; (ii) it has an adequate number of employees in Vanuatu; (iii) it incurs adequate operating expenditure in Vanuatu; (iv) it maintains physical premises in Vanuatu; and (v) the core income-generating activities are performed in Vanuatu. Intercompany pricing should still be benchmarked on arm's length terms as a matter of international best practice to avoid red flags in the home jurisdiction of the ultimate beneficial owner.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable. The International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019 (as amended) applies to all ICs carrying on a relevant activity. A subscription-box IC that purchases subscription-box inventory from a connected person and resells it to customers, or distributes goods or services for a connected person, conducts the relevant activity of distribution and service centre. The IC must maintain economic substance proportionate to the activity: local board meetings and records, local management, local employees, local premises, and locally performed core income-generating activities (order management, inventory handling, logistics, and customer-support functions). An annual ESR notification must be filed with the VFSC; the VFSC and the Domestic Revenue Department cooperate with foreign tax authorities through information-exchange mechanisms. Non-compliance exposes the IC to court-ordered penalties of up to VUV 10,000,000 and/or imprisonment of up to 2 years, continuing daily default fines, and deregistration.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC books substantial subscription-box revenue and holds related-party payables and receivables but has no physical office, no local payroll, no board meetings in Vanuatu, and no locally performed core income-generating activities, or fails to file the annual ESR notification.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Court-imposed penalty of up to VUV 10,000,000 and/or imprisonment of up to 2 years for the company and responsible officers, plus continuing daily penalties; VFSC deregistration of the IC; automatic exchange of information with the jurisdiction of the ultimate parent and beneficial owner.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who consented or connived in the breach are personally liable to fines and imprisonment; the court may order surrender of passports and travel restrictions, freeze personal assets, and require personal restitution of diverted profits; the corporate veil does not shield directors in ESR prosecutions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Submitting false statements to the VFSC or the Domestic Revenue Department, including false beneficial-ownership details, inflated or fictitious subscription revenue, fraudulent VAT export zero-rating claims, forged shipping documents, or falsely claiming IC tax-exempt status for an entity that has conducted prohibited domestic trading.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal conviction with fines and imprisonment under the ICA and the VAT Act; VAT default assessments, penalty tax and interest; cancellation of the certificate of incorporation; court orders for restitution of diverted profits; and potential confiscation of the subscription-box business assets.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the signatory officers are prosecuted personally as principal offenders, not merely as agents of the company; civil restitution orders attach to personal assets; travel bans may be imposed pending criminal proceedings; and imprisonment of natural persons applies for conviction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing subscription-card payments for third parties without a valid VFSC financial services licence, engaging in money-value transmission without authorization, failing to maintain AML/KYC records required of specified non-financial businesses under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act, or laundering the proceeds of the subscription-box activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Substantial fines under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act, confiscation of the proceeds of crime, imprisonment for money-laundering offences, revocation of any VFSC authorization, and freezing of the IC's bank accounts by court order.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal money-laundering convictions, confiscation orders against personal and corporate assets, passport surrender and travel restrictions, cross-border asset-tracing exposure, and lifting of the corporate veil so that the ultimate beneficial owner can be pursued directly.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Prohibited Domestic Trading Without Business Licence
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC sells subscription boxes to Vanuatu residents, maintains a physical fulfillment depot serving local customers, or signs contracts subject to Vanuatu domestic law without holding a Business Licence under the Business Licence Act, Cap. 240, thereby exceeding the narrow trading boundary permitted to international companies.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The offending contracts are unenforceable in Vanuatu courts; monetary fines are imposed per contravention under the Business Licence Act; the IC's tax-exempt status may be suspended; and the VFSC may strike the company off the register.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors risk personal fines, disqualification from managing any Vanuatu-licensed entity, and criminal liability for continued abuse; the court may issue management disqualification orders and travel restrictions during proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Concealing the true natural-person owner of the subscription-box IC in the VFSC annual return, the ESR notification, or the registered agent's KYC file, or using nominee shareholders to misrepresent control and revenue attribution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines and imprisonment for false declarations under the ICA; confiscation of shares and dividends; deregistration of the IC; and exchange of information with the home tax authority of the ultimate beneficial owner through CRS and intergovernmental cooperation channels.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The ultimate beneficial owner and each signatory director face personal criminal liability, including imprisonment, international travel bans, asset-freeze orders, and disqualification from holding office in any VFSC-regulated entity; the corporate veil is pierced to attribute the subscription-box profits to the true owner.
